physical.mounting-hardware: Nylon spacer x6 and 8-32 screw x6 (installation sheet)

configs.description: The set as APC ships AR7722: a 23U and a 20U length.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the installation sheet draws each finger in an isometric or face-on figure that is not dimensioned. Its height, length and the shape of its tip are read off the figure and estimated.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the rail or back plate

gaps.note: the data sheet states no cable capacity, so none is recorded and none is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

gaps.note: which NetShelter SX cabinets take this manager is stated only by the data sheet's title and the installation sheet's; no cabinet model number is listed, and the library has no NetShelter SX enclosure to place it in.
gaps.wanted: the maker's compatibility list, and the cabinet's accessory channel drawing

gaps.note: the installation sheet shows the manager hooked onto keyhole slots in the cabinet's accessory channel and held by screws; the slots' pitch and the hooks are not dimensioned and are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the manager fitted to the channel

gaps.note: the set is two lengths, 23U and 20U; they are drawn end to end and the joint is not dimensioned. Which of the two stands higher is read off the installation sheet's figures (the 23U above, page 2). Both stand in one well 45 deep, the depth of the part.
gaps.wanted: a drawing of the two lengths fitted to one side
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - "Color: Black", the provided equipment (2 x vertical cable organizers, installation guide); the installation sheet lists six nylon spacers and six 8-32 screws.

bottom.note: estimated - the plan again; the two ends are alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - no cable capacity is stated (see `gaps`).

chassis.note: datasheet - 107 x 1911 x 45: "Width 4.2 in (107 mm)", "Height 75.2 in (1911 mm)", "Depth 1.8 in (45 mm)", for the set of two lengths. The height is drawn 1911.35, the 43 rack units of the two lengths, so they stand end to end with no overlap; the sheet prints whole millimetres.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". The shade is the library's render of black plastic.

front.note: estimated - the face the installation sheet draws: the 23U length above the 20U, a rail down the left edge and a loop to each of 43 rack units.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the run down the loops, at one rack unit pitch, the gap the pitch less the 31 mm loop.

left.note: estimated - the rail's edge down the part, read from the plan.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as data: the AR7722 data sheet and the installation sheet 990-5140A. The data sheet's height, width, depth and weight are `datasheet`. The sheet's 1911 mm is the two lengths end to end: the installation sheet labels them 20U and 23U, 20 x 44.45 + 23 x 44.45 = 1911.35. Everything read off the sheet's figures is estimated and said so. No drawing or photograph is copied.

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-side`: "Number of rack unit 0U", "Mounting Location Side" and the installation sheet (990-5140A) hooks it onto the side of the cabinet, in the zero-U space. `ru: 43` is the 23U and the 20U length it is made of. Which side is a placement's to say.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the same loops, the rail on the right.

right.note: estimated - the loops' ends down the part.

shell.note: estimated - the loops are drawn as slabs the depth of the part; no view sections a loop.

thickness.note: estimated - no document states a gauge; the parts carry their own depths.

top.note: estimated - the plan: the rail and the top loop's edge.

weight.note: datasheet - "Net Weight 5.004 lb(US) (2.27 kg)" for the set of two; packed 2.73 kg.
